workload: 64,509 post-Twig Altimood Markdown blocks; Comrak via persistent NativeWorker with PHP fallback
method: Three separate uncached PHP workers on one CPU. PHP baseline times transform() only. Hybrid times reused-worker requests and PHP transform() for declined blocks. Every produced block is compared byte-for-byte with the private snapshot and the aggregate digest matches the downstream PHP baseline.
limits: The native link markup matches the default Pushword component; the PHP Markdown filter uses PHP for custom link templates and admin-specific title changes, which are not represented in the worker request.
The downstream site has its own installed Pushword version; this does not prove parity with the current monorepo PHP parser.
Post-Twig block parity does not prove complete page, admin preview, static build or HTTP parity.
Kernel startup, Twig expansion, snapshot decoding, SQL, cache hits and complete page assembly are outside these timings.
One run had a large timing outlier. The earlier benchmark was a separate run, so a change in measured speedup alone should not be attributed to the link port.
